title: Cuban chain corners
prompt: A panoramic luxury hip-hop jewelry still life, oversized solid 18-karat yellow gold Cuban link chains entering from the far left and far right corners, beautifully interlocked rounded links with real weight and thickness, broad polished surfaces with subtle wear, chains curve out of frame before reaching the center, expansive matte black negative space in the middle, warm controlled studio reflections, minimal contemporary composition, confident and understated, no pendants, no letters, no people.
